title: Wind and saturated ground
summary: Days of rain have saturated Hillcrest slopes. A ground-risk restriction removes the West Descent road while strong wind makes elevated mast maintenance infeasible; the coordinator must find a valid alternative.
provenance: Synthetic design event authored for the POC. Not derived from observations.
assumptions: Slope susceptibility is a simplified index (susceptibility x saturation squared), not a geotechnical model.
A road closed for ground risk stays closed for the rest of the event.
Elevated work is limited to 12 m/s sustained site wind.
known_constraints: Mast securing cannot start before winds exceed its working limit.
One mobile communications unit is available at the depot.
expected_behavior: West Descent closes for ground risk early. The telecom mast fails in the wind peak without action. A valid plan substitutes the mobile communications unit and reaches Harbor Flats via the hill roads.

params.notes: Ground team reported fresh cracking on the West Descent embankment.
